rules: Claude usage_updated is a context-window snapshot, not token-cost deltas; final turn usage omits cache creation. Deduplicate native assistant message IDs and reconcile input/cache-read/output to terminal event.

Codex usage_updated overwrites latest usage from tokenUsage.last; final event repeats it. Do not sum notifications. Use native token_usage_record keyed by response_id and turn_id; fresh one-request turns reconcile to final event.
Provider requests here means recorded completed model requests, not invisible HTTP retries; every measured turn had one recorded request and zero tool calls.
Paseo off configuration resolves disabled in source, while the captured Claude native request shows adaptive/medium; actual off was not verified.
